causalQuestion: Can a Blender Bullet-evaluated basketball impact tip a half-filled open glass tumbler and thereby cause a Blender Mantaflow liquid volume to leave the opening and spread on the court, with no authored contact frame, spill frame, final cup pose or final fluid mesh?
selectionReason: RC5 already proves rigid contact and one breakable attachment. The largest visible remaining physical falsehood is static liquid. A bounded Bullet-to-Mantaflow consequence directly tests that missing physics instead of adding decorative debris, camera shake, particles or another rigid accessory.

scope.scene: one metric basketball, one half-filled open glass tumbler, one court support, one bounded liquid domain
scope.coupling: Bullet container motion is evaluated first and baked; Mantaflow samples the moving container as an effector. Fluid does not feed forces back into Bullet.

visualAcceptance: the wide frame clearly establishes ball, open container, liquid and travel direction
contact is continuous without a visible gap or teleport
the container tips continuously from the impact rather than from pose animation
liquid remains visibly inside the container before impact
liquid visibly crosses the opening only after the physical response begins
the spill develops continuously across the full clip rather than appearing as a replacement mesh
the effect frame shows a readable container, opening and floor spread relationship
the liquid reads as a coherent volume rather than decorative particles
lighting and camera preserve contact and fluid silhouette without concealing failures
the result is honestly readable as one-way Bullet-to-Mantaflow coupling, not two-way fluid dynamics
stopRules: stop and retain the attempt if either frozen root already exists
stop before scene creation if binary identity or resource admission fails
stop after the first failed Blender process; do not rerun inside the same root
do not weaken physics, persistence, visual or resource thresholds after observing the result
a machine pass remains pending until every rendered clip frame is directly inspected
forbidden: film-engine source, commit, ref, tag or release mutation
authored contact frame, spill frame, cup final pose or fluid final mesh
animated inflow timed to the impact
particles, compositor blur, camera shake or sound used as a substitute for missing liquid motion
network call, signing, notarization, DMG or binary distribution
claimCeiling: A PASS would establish one bounded M2 Max Bullet-to-Mantaflow liquid consequence with one-way coupling and a wide-mouth tumbler. It would not establish two-way fluid/rigid coupling, narrow-neck bottle flow, liquid volume conservation at production tolerance, production render quality, arbitrary scenes or cross-platform support.
